key_features: ADVANCED SLEEP INSIGHTS & AUTOMATIC TRACKING: Unlike basic audio monitors or standard WiFi cameras, this smart baby monitor acts as sleep coaching for parents, delivering everything you need in one of your baby must haves. Automatically track sleep duration, efficiency, and baby positioning. Monitor nursery conditions, cough/cry detection, and get AI-powered sleep coach insights with next nap predictions and long-term trends to optimize your baby’s routine.

STAY CONNECTED FROM ANYWHERE: Delivering peace of mind for parents, the Nanit baby monitor with an app keeps your family synced 24/7. Live-stream 1080p HD video to your smartphone, Alexa, Google Home, or the 8" display, perfect for grandparents and babysitters as an alternative to the smartphone app. Soothe your baby remotely with crisp Two-Way Audio and monitor them in dark rooms with crystal-clear Infrared Night Vision.

TWO WAYS TO SET UP, ONE SEAMLESS SYSTEM: Ideal for shared bedrooms or dedicated nurseries, choose versatile setup options like a floor stand or wall mount that secures easily to drywall or plaster. Access everything from the integrated 8" touchscreen display viewed from your living room, or the Nanit app. It’s the complete system for baby essentials for newborn, keeping all your tools in one seamless place.

CAPTURE EVERY FIRST, AUTOMATICALLY: Growing with your child from the newborn stage through toddler developmental milestones, Nanit's baby monitor with camera and audio auto-captures sleep sessions, milestones, and memories. Review, save, and share the moments you'd otherwise miss, no manual logging required. It features temperature and humidity sensors to monitor summer heat or winter dryness, ensuring comfort through every season.

YOUR PARENTING PARTNER FROM NIGHT ONE: This smart system is a true newborn must-have, automatically logging sleep and enabling easy manual tracking for feeding and diaper changes. Share access with caregivers to manage your newborn baby essentials routine. Requires a WiFi router connection, but local network viewing ensures the monitor continues working during internet outages, so everyone stays on the same page.

TECHNICAL ECOSYSTEM & BATTERY LIFE: Compatible with iOS/Android, Alexa, and Google Home, the system includes local monitoring offline functionality to ensure your connection remains stable during internet outages. The portable display features a 3–6 hour battery life and charges to 100% in under 2.5 hours. Note: Initial camera setup requires a subscription and internet access.
review_summary: Does it work without a subscription? Yes. You will always have access to the 1080p HD live stream, sound/motion alerts, two-way audio, and care logs without a subscription. Advanced features, including personalized sleep insights, video history,,and milestone video captures, require a subscription. A 3-month free trial of the Sleep Insights plan is included with purchase and can be canceled at any time before auto-renewal. Can I turn off the display screen at night? Absolutely. The 8” Home Display features an auto-dim mode and a "Background Audio" setting. This allows you to keep the screen dark while still hearing every sound from the nursery, which also extends the battery life for overnight use. Can I still hear my baby without having the app open? Yes, the Nanit app features a “Background Audio” setting. The background sound will continue to play when your screen is off. The default seeing for this feature is turned off. When you’re ready to listen in, simply tap the microphone for 3 settings: background audio on, audio on and audio muted. What age range is this most suitable for? Ages 0-4
